result.fix: Install a newer kernel with `sudo dnf upgrade kernel`, reboot into it and confirm with `uname -r`.
result.message: Kernel `5.14.0-362.el9.x86_64` is older than the minimum of 5.14.0-400. distro_min has an entry for `rhel`, which `rocky` lists in ID_LIKE. It is not applied to `rocky`. Ask the vendor to add a `rocky` entry.
